product-form.quote: Brewer's Yeast tablets for all dogs

active-ingredient.quote: 8in1 Brewer's Yeast tablets are perfect as a daily supplement

health-feature.quote: For a healthy and shiny coat

texts.about_this_item: 8in1 Excel Brewer's Yeast is a daily feed supplement for dogs and cats that helps promote healthy skin and a shiny coat. Developed with veterinarians, it combines brewer's yeast rich in B-complex vitamins (including B1, B2, B6 and biotin) with garlic, fish oil as a source of omega-3 fatty acids, and balanced minerals such as zinc and iron. Free from artificial colours and preservatives. Made in Germany. 260 tablets.
